pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:1.2: tena kho pana samayena saṃgho sannipatito hoti kenacid eva karaṇīyena.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:1.3: chabbaggiyā bhikkhū cīvarakammaṃ karontā ekassa chandaṃ adaṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:1.4: atha kho saṃgho yass' atthāya sannipatito taṃ kammaṃ karissāmīti ñattiṃ ṭhapesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:1.6: evam ev' ime ekamekassa kammaṃ karonti, kassa tumhe kammaṃ karissathā 'ti chandaṃ adatvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:1.8: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhu saṃghe vinicchayakathāya vattamānāya chandaṃ adatvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamissatīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:1.9: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ bhikkhu saṃghe vinicchayakathāya . . . pakkamasīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:1.12: hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa saṃghe vinicchayakathāya . . . pakkamissasi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:1.13: n' etaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:1.14: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:1.15.1: yo pana bhikkhu saṃghe vinicchayakathāya vattamānāya chandaṃ adatvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkameyya, pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:2.1.6: vatthu vā ārocitaṃ hoti avinicchitaṃ ñatti vā ṭhapitā hoti kammavācā vā vippakatā hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:2.1.8: kathaṃ idaṃ kammaṃ kuppaṃ assa vaggaṃ assa na kareyyā 'ti gacchati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:2.2.1: dhammakamme dhammakammasaññī chandaṃ adatvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamati, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:2.3.2: saṃghassa bhaṇḍanaṃ vā kalaho vā viggaho vā vivādo vā bhavissatīti gacchati,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:2.3.3: saṃghabhedo vā saṃgharāji vā bhavissatīti gacchati,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:2.3.4: adhammena vā vaggena vā na kammārahassa vā kammaṃ karissatīti gacchati,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:2.3.7: uccārena vā passāvena vā pīḷito gacchati,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc80:2.3.8: na kammaṃ kopetukāmo puna paccāgamissāmīti gacchati,
